items.title: General Motors (GM) Stock Fair Value Rises After Mixed Q2 Analyst Reactions
items.summary: General Motors now carries a higher fair value estimate, with the price target moving from US$94.81 to US$100.04 per share. That shift sits against a backdrop of mixed analyst reactions to Q2 results, guidance changes, and the long term earnings profile through 2027 and beyond. As you read on, you will see how different parts of the updated narrative could matter for how you follow General Motors from here.
